why: Reports the POOLED span distribution under the expiry-ended name, collapsing the two columns the row exists to contrast. The pooled number mixes the spans the threshold chose to end with the ones rule 5 forced, and rule 5 is 63-88% of every change recorded on each of two disjoint 200-seed sets, so it answers the parameter far more weakly: measured over seeds 1-200 at 1800 ticks, MOBILE_MINE_LAYER's pooled median moves 148 -> 241 ticks across 0.5s -> 6s while its expiry-ended median moves 279 -> 722. Under this mutation both columns print that weaker 148 -> 241 series under two different names, and a tuning decision reading it would still see a plausible rising number.
killedBy: groupRows reports the expiry-ended spans beside the pooled ones gives each group a distribution over only the spans its threshold ended
